title: Canceling an appointment and asking about a fee

persona.name: Tom Becker
persona.style: matter-of-fact, slightly worried about being charged

goals.goal: Cancel your appointment later this week; something came up at work.
Ask whether there's a cancellation fee or a notice policy.
Get a clear confirmation that the appointment is cancelled.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: For calling Pivot Point Orthopaedics. Part of [company]. How may I help you today?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Hi, I'm calling to cancel my appointment later this week. Something came up at work.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Can you please provide your full name and date of birth?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Sure, it's Tom Becker, and my date of birth is February 14, 1968. Please go ahead and cancel that appointment for me.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Before I can help with your request, can you please spell your first and last name for me?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yeah, sure. That's T-O-M B-E-C-K-E-R. Now, can you please confirm the cancellation of my appointment?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Would you like to use your phone number to look up your record? If so, please tell me the number you have on file with us If you are not sure, I can confirm your name and date of birth again. Which would you prefer?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text:
I'd like to use my phone number, please. It's 805-555-0131. Can you please find my appointment and confirm the cancellation?
Also, can you tell me if there's any cancellation fee or notice policy I should be aware of?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I have your phone number as eight zero five five five five zero one three one. And your date of birth as February fourteenth nineteen sixty eight. Is that correct?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yeah, that's right. So, can you please cancel my appointment and confirm that it's done? Also, let me know if there's any cancellation fee or notice policy.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I can't proceed further right now. But I can make sure our clinic support team follows up with you. Would you like me to connect you to our patient support team?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: No, that's okay. I just want to make sure my appointment is cancelled now and hear about any fees. If you can't do that, I'll have to call back later. Thanks. Goodbye.
